_about: Seed groups for the 2026-10-09 skin-microneedling keyword universe (scripts/keyword-research-adjacent.py, markets US GB DE NL). Malcolm, 2026-10-09: microneedling for skin is a core product category; rank first for its top keywords. 'suggest' = phrase-match suggestions (every keyword containing the seed, by volume); 'q' = the same filtered to questions and modifiers (English, German and Dutch words); 'related' = Google's related-searches graph, depth 2. Hair terms are dropped at enrich by the strategy's off-intent filter (they belong to Hairgenetix) but stay in the raw pull for the overlap check.
